t: A little bird told me - Idioms by The Free Dictionary
s: A phrase used when one does not want to reveal the source of the information that one is about to share or has shared. A: "Did you hear that Mark is planning to propose to Sarah soon?"

t: A LITTLE BIRD TOLD ME definition in American English | Collins English Dictionary
s: said to mean that you are not going to say how you found out about something or who told it to you. This expression is considered old-fashioned in American English. Incidentally, a little bird told me that your birthday's coming up.

Why do we say A little bird told me?
